svg.aria-label: Two drawings of a working day. On the left, labelled then: one desk with a big monitor, a good chair and a keyboard, with a solid block of work from nine to five. On the right, labelled now: the same day scattered across a phone on the train, the kitchen bench, the couch, a park bench and the bedside table, each with a small check-in dot, and a cloud above them labelled agents running.
svg.text: the same job, a few years apart
the work didn't shrink. it spread out.
